html:
SMTO-CTX-0005 — Your request and the model's answer won't fit together

GUID: 08f8f81f-0d33-4311-9346-691f4172e354
Slug: request-preflight-exceeds-context-window
Domain: CTX · Subsystem: context

What happened

  • Before sending a step, SMTO checks that your request and the space kept for the model's answer fit together. They didn't, so nothing was sent to the model for this step.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In the message box, check Output limit. If you set it very high, move it lower or select Default next to it. Room kept for the answer comes out of the same total, so a smaller answer limit leaves more room for your request.
  2. Open Settings › Setup › Model routing, open Main, then Limits and recovery. Check Output allowance isn't unusually high, and leave Context ceiling blank (Auto) unless you know the server's real limit. Setting a bigger limit than the server supports doesn't add room; it only makes the numbers wrong.
  3. Start a new task with a shorter request or fewer attached files. These settings apply to new tasks, and a smaller request is the surest way to fit.

What success looks like

  • The new task runs past this step and the model starts answering.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO; the details show how much room the request and the answer needed. Don't raise Output allowance to fix this; it makes the problem worse.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Local request preflight found that the prepared input plus the reserved output exceeds the effective context window, so the inference request was not started.

What this means

  • Before opening inference transport, SMTO compares the prepared input plus reserved output against effective model capacity. The check failed, so this inference request was not started. Measurements may come from a tokenizer or a local estimate; neither permits inventing additional model capacity by raising a configuration number.

Why this can happen

  • Prepared input plus reserved output exceeds the effective context window used by preflight.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare input tokens, output reservation and context capacity in this occurrence. Check the measurement source; a local estimate may differ from the provider tokenizer.
  • Confirm the configured context ceiling does not exceed the capacity actually served by the selected model.

How to fix it

  • Compare input_tokens_before_compaction and reserved_output_tokens with context_window_tokens in the error facts (raised in llm/native_tool_client.py _complete_tools). Reduce the input or the output reservation (composer Output limit, or Output allowance in Settings › Setup › Model routing), and verify Context ceiling against the served model's real capacity; a larger configured number cannot create capacity.
  • Reduce input or output reservation where appropriate. Verify the configured context ceiling against the actual served model capacity; a larger configured number cannot create capacity.

Relevant SMTO settings

  • Open Context Window: model-configuration / llm_context_window_tokens. Applies to: new task.
  • Start a new task after changing this setting. Active and resumed tasks retain their captured values.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • Confirm the next request passes context preflight.
  • Confirm existing completed tool results and receipts remain preserved without replay.

What not to do

  • Do not increase max completion tokens as the primary fix; reserving more output reduces input headroom.
  • Do not claim an inference response occurred when the model request did not start.

Technical notes

  • This capacity branch occurs before the next inference request starts. Prior tool receipts are preserved and token estimates retain provenance.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-CTX-0002 — A step's results were too large to send to the model
  • SMTO-CTX-0003 — Your current request is too big for the model
  • SMTO-CTX-0004 — This step needs more room than the model has
  • SMTO-CTX-0006 — Your request is too large for SMTO to plan the task
